# reveal.js 5.1.0 (vendored)

`slides.html` is built with reveal.js, inlined into the file so the slides open offline with no CDN. These are the unmodified distribution files.

| File | Downloaded from (2026-10-21) | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `reveal.min.js` | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/reveal.js/5.1.0/reveal.min.js | `e19badb4a9753a29c524e2fe891233d5d73b2a395939608a596838252e6e0243` |
| `reveal.min.css` | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/reveal.js/5.1.0/reveal.min.css | `cdfb19cbb4574d907846028d87f25aa8fd8331e3c8b3a5471d97d7bcb21bdda5` |
| `LICENSE` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hakimel/reveal.js/5.1.0/LICENSE | — |

- **License:** MIT. Copyright (C) 2011-2024 Hakim El Hattab and reveal.js contributors. The license text is in `LICENSE`, and `slides.html` repeats the copyright notice above the inlined code.
- **Used only by** `scripts/build_deliverables.py`. The app itself does not load it.
- No theme or plugin is used. The slide styles are GrantBridge's own and are written in the build script.
